A '''medtox detector''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It was a component of the [[broad-spectrum sensor suite]] used in [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam]]/[[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|RSMA]]'s [[Bioscan Unit]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
